_comment: Override keys are canonical public names shared by all aliases: canonical key applies to the single canonical row. Baseline rejects [capabilities] at startup.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"
aliases = ["m-a-alias"]

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning]
supported = true
name: m4_capability_override_canonical_applies
